title: Language Models: Participles of Background
grammar: Background Participles in Texts about Models
goal: I can add a background to a sentence with a participle (*figyelembe véve, eltekintve*).
I can name the main terms of language models (*transzformátor-architektúra, beágyazás, finomhangolás*).
I can say how a model works with *révén*.
